answer: Duplicate identities collapse because the seed diverges, forcing attackers to fund fresh stakes per identity, a cost that compounds like crossing an oasis into barren tundra. Participants stake a bonded deposit to register, and each epoch they must solve a unique challenge seeded by their on-chain history, like tracing a lotus from murky water to clear bloom. Honest peers attest only verifiable work, so sybil farms burn capital faster than they earn rewards. In practice, Agent0269 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
